notes: Market backdrop: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share (about $81.3B in the offering and about $107.3B with the concurrent private placement) above its preliminary range and begins Nasdaq trading today under ANT. The print reignited the AI trade and the whole AI-infrastructure complex moved as ONE group pre-market — optical, storage/memory and neocloud names alike — so a cluster of names on the ladder share a single driver and none of them is an independent setup.

The Focus book and the market's book barely overlap: of the ten largest pre-market gaps, only SHAZ and SLS are also on the prior session's Focus list. That is the structural point of this routine — the Focus list is a momentum screen built on the previous session, so it cannot contain a name whose move has not happened yet.

Gold and silver hit 52-week lows overnight, so the metals complex is the one part of the tape moving DOWN for a macro reason rather than a company reason; Seabridge (SA) carries a company-specific overlay on top of it.

Driver-class caveat: the crypto proxy is only pulled when a crypto name sits on the Focus list, and no Focus name is a crypto name this morning. The neocloud and crypto-linked names on the ladder therefore carry IDIOSYNCRATIC driver classes even though they visibly moved with the AI trade — read those classes as 'no index proxy within 1.5pp', not as 'no shared story'.

No Focus-list name has an earnings date today, so the forward calendar is empty for this book; the market-wide ladder carries no same-day print either, so the day's gap leaders are event-driven (offerings, court rulings, analyst actions) rather than earnings-driven.
